1904:       elsif timer >= @bg_1_appear_start
1905:         @flash_viewport.color.alpha = 0   # Ensure flash has ended
1906:         # BG 1 sprite appears
1907:         proportion = (timer - @bg_1_appear_start) / (@bg_1_appear_end - @bg_1_appear_start)
1908:         half_height = ((proportion * @bg_1_bitmap.height) / 2).to_i
1909:         @bg_1_sprite.src_rect.height = half_height * 2
1910:         @bg_1_sprite.src_rect.y = (@bg_1_bitmap.height / 2) - half_height
1911:         @bg_1_sprite.oy = half_height
1912:       elsif timer >= @strobe_appear_end
1913:         @sprites.each { |sprite| sprite.opacity = 255 }   # Ensure strobes are fully opaque
1914:         # Flash the screen white
1915:         proportion = (timer - @strobe_appear_end) / (@bg_1_appear_start - @strobe_appear_end)
1916:         if proportion >= 0.5
1917:           @flash_viewport.color.alpha = 320 * 2 * (1 - proportion)
1918:         else
1919:           @flash_viewport.color.alpha = 320 * proportion
1920:         end
1921:       else
1922:         # Strobes fade in
1923:         @sprites.each do |sprite|
1924:           sprite.opacity = 255 * (timer / @strobe_appear_end)
1925:         end
1926:       end
1927:     end

376:             tone_red = @target_tone.red + ((1 - fract) * (@old_tone.red - @target_tone.red))

395:           weather_type = @target_type

405:         tone_red = base_tone.red
406:         tone_green = base_tone.green
407:         tone_blue = base_tone.blue
408:         tone_gray = base_tone.gray

69:   def radiusMax; return 176; end   # After using Flash

71:   def radius=(value)
72:     @radius = value.round
73:     refresh
74:   end

76:   def refresh
77:     @darkness.fill_rect(0, 0, Graphics.width, Graphics.height, Color.black)
78:     cx = Graphics.width / 2
79:     cy = Graphics.height / 2
80:     cradius = @radius
81:     numfades = 5
82:     (1..numfades).each do |i|
83:       (cx - cradius..cx + cradius).each do |j|
84:         diff2 = (cradius * cradius) - ((j - cx) * (j - cx))
85:         diff = Math.sqrt(diff2)
86:         @darkness.fill_rect(j, cy - diff, 1, diff * 2, Color.new(0, 0, 0, 255.0 * (numfades - i) / numfades))
87:       end
88:       cradius = (cradius * 0.9).floor
89:     end
90:   end

175: class LightEffect_DayNight < LightEffect
176:   def initialize(event, viewport = nil, map = nil, filename = nil)
177:     super
178:     @light.ox = @light.bitmap.width / 2
179:     @light.oy = @light.bitmap.height / 2
180:   end

182:   def update
183:     return if !@light || !@event
184:     super
185:     shade = PBDayNight.getShade
186:     if shade >= 144   # If light enough, call it fully day
187:       shade = 255
188:     elsif shade <= 64   # If dark enough, call it fully night
189:       shade = 0
190:     else
191:       shade = 255 - (255 * (144 - shade) / (144 - 64))
192:     end
193:     @light.opacity = 255 - shade
194:     if @light.opacity > 0
195:       if (Object.const_defined?(:ScreenPosHelper) rescue false)
196:         @light.x      = ScreenPosHelper.pbScreenX(@event)
197:         @light.y      = ScreenPosHelper.pbScreenY(@event) - (@event.height * Game_Map::TILE_HEIGHT / 2)
198:         @light.zoom_x = ScreenPosHelper.pbScreenZoomX(@event)
199:         @light.zoom_y = ScreenPosHelper.pbScreenZoomY(@event)
200:       else
201:         @light.x = @event.screen_x
202:         @light.y = @event.screen_y - (Game_Map::TILE_HEIGHT / 2)
203:       end
204:       @light.tone.set($game_screen.tone.red,
205:                       $game_screen.tone.green,
206:                       $game_screen.tone.blue,
207:                       $game_screen.tone.gray)
208:     end
209:   end
210: end

1: #===============================================================================
2: # Entering/exiting cave animations
3: #===============================================================================
4: def pbCaveEntranceEx(exiting)
5:   # Create bitmap
6:   sprite = BitmapSprite.new(Graphics.width, Graphics.height)
7:   sprite.z = 100000
8:   # Define values used for the animation
9:   duration = 0.4
10:   totalBands = 15
11:   bandheight = ((Graphics.height / 2.0) - 10) / totalBands
12:   bandwidth  = ((Graphics.width / 2.0) - 12) / totalBands
13:   start_gray = (exiting) ? 0 : 255
14:   end_gray = (exiting) ? 255 : 0
15:   # Create initial array of band colors (black if exiting, white if entering)
16:   grays = Array.new(totalBands) { |i| start_gray }
17:   # Animate bands changing color
18:   timer_start = System.uptime
19:   until System.uptime - timer_start >= duration
20:     x = 0
21:     y = 0
22:     # Calculate color of each band
23:     totalBands.times do |k|
24:       grays[k] = lerp(start_gray, end_gray, duration, timer_start + (k * duration / totalBands), System.uptime)
25:     end
26:     # Draw gray rectangles
27:     rectwidth  = Graphics.width
28:     rectheight = Graphics.height
29:     totalBands.times do |i|
30:       currentGray = grays[i]
31:       sprite.bitmap.fill_rect(Rect.new(x, y, rectwidth, rectheight),
32:                               Color.new(currentGray, currentGray, currentGray))
33:       x += bandwidth
34:       y += bandheight
35:       rectwidth  -= bandwidth * 2
36:       rectheight -= bandheight * 2
37:     end
38:     Graphics.update
39:     Input.update
40:   end
41:   # Set the tone at end of band animation
42:   if exiting
43:     pbToneChangeAll(Tone.new(255, 255, 255), 0)
44:   else
45:     pbToneChangeAll(Tone.new(-255, -255, -255), 0)
46:   end
47:   # Animate fade to white (if exiting) or black (if entering)
48:   timer_start = System.uptime
49:   loop do
50:     sprite.color = Color.new(end_gray, end_gray, end_gray,
51:                              lerp(0, 255, duration, timer_start, System.uptime))
52:     Graphics.update
53:     Input.update
54:     break if sprite.color.alpha >= 255
55:   end
56:   # Set the tone at end of fading animation
57:   pbToneChangeAll(Tone.new(0, 0, 0), 8)
58:   # Pause briefly
59:   timer_start = System.uptime
60:   until System.uptime - timer_start >= 0.1
61:     Graphics.update
62:     Input.update
63:   end
64:   sprite.dispose
65: end

{"kind": "source", "path": "Data/Scripts/012_Overworld/002_Battle triggering/002_Overworld_BattleIntroAnim.rb", "git_blob": "7d81522370e0c361ab220263f5c71cc8840ad747", "range": [1, 432]}
1: #===============================================================================
2: # Registers special battle transition animations which may be used instead of
3: # the default ones. There are examples below of how to register them.
4: #
5: # The register call has 4 arguments:
6: #    1) The name of the animation. Typically unused, but helps to identify the
7: #       registration code for a particular animation if necessary.
8: #    2) The animation's priority. If multiple special animations could trigger
9: #       for the same battle, the one with the highest priority number is used.
10: #    3) A condition proc which decides whether the animation should trigger.
11: #    4) The animation itself. Could be a bunch of code, or a call to, say,
12: #       pbCommonEvent(20) or something else. By the end of the animation, the
13: #       screen should be black.
14: # Note that you can get an image of the current game screen with
15: # Graphics.snap_to_bitmap.
16: #===============================================================================
17: module SpecialBattleIntroAnimations
18:   # [name, priority number, "trigger if" proc, animation proc]
19:   @@anims = []
20: 
21:   def self.register(name, priority, condition, hash)
22:     @@anims.push([name, priority, condition, hash])
23:   end
24: 
25:   def self.remove(name)
26:     @@anims.delete_if { |anim| anim[0] == name }
27:   end
28: 
29:   def self.each
30:     ret = @@anims.sort { |a, b| b[1] <=> a[1] }
31:     ret.each { |anim| yield anim[0], anim[1], anim[2], anim[3] }
32:   end
33: 
34:   def self.has?(name)
35:     return @@anims.any? { |anim| anim[0] == name }
36:   end
37: 
38:   def self.get(name)
39:     @@anims.each { |anim| return anim if anim[0] == name }
40:     return nil
41:   end
42: end

59: def pbBattleAnimation(bgm = nil, battletype = 0, foe = nil)
60:   $game_temp.in_battle = true
61:   viewport = Viewport.new(0, 0, Graphics.width, Graphics.height)
62:   viewport.z = 99999
63:   # Set up audio
64:   playingBGS = nil
65:   playingBGM = nil
66:   if $game_system.is_a?(Game_System)
67:     playingBGS = $game_system.getPlayingBGS
68:     playingBGM = $game_system.getPlayingBGM
69:     $game_system.bgm_pause
70:     $game_system.bgs_pause
71:     if $game_temp.memorized_bgm
72:       playingBGM = $game_temp.memorized_bgm
73:       $game_system.bgm_position = $game_temp.memorized_bgm_position
74:     end
75:   end
76:   # Play battle music
77:   bgm = pbGetWildBattleBGM([]) if !bgm
78:   pbBGMPlay(bgm)
79:   # Determine location of battle
80:   location = 0   # 0=outside, 1=inside, 2=cave, 3=water
81:   if $PokemonGlobal.surfing || $PokemonGlobal.diving
82:     location = 3
83:   elsif $game_temp.encounter_type &&
84:         GameData::EncounterType.get($game_temp.encounter_type).type == :fishing
85:     location = 3
86:   elsif $PokemonEncounters.has_cave_encounters?
87:     location = 2
88:   elsif !$game_map.metadata&.outdoor_map
89:     location = 1
90:   end
91:   # Check for custom battle intro animations
92:   handled = false
93:   SpecialBattleIntroAnimations.each do |name, priority, condition, animation|
94:     next if !condition.call(battletype, foe, location)
95:     animation.call(viewport, battletype, foe, location)
96:     handled = true
97:     break
98:   end
99:   # Default battle intro animation
100:   if !handled
101:     # Determine which animation is played
102:     anim = ""
103:     if PBDayNight.isDay?
104:       case battletype
105:       when 0, 2   # Wild, double wild
106:         anim = ["SnakeSquares", "DiagonalBubbleTL", "DiagonalBubbleBR", "RisingSplash"][location]
107:       when 1      # Trainer
108:         anim = ["TwoBallPass", "ThreeBallDown", "BallDown", "WavyThreeBallUp"][location]
109:       when 3      # Double trainer
110:         anim = "FourBallBurst"
111:       end
112:     else
113:       case battletype
114:       when 0, 2   # Wild, double wild
115:         anim = ["SnakeSquares", "DiagonalBubbleBR", "DiagonalBubbleBR", "RisingSplash"][location]
116:       when 1      # Trainer
117:         anim = ["SpinBallSplit", "BallDown", "BallDown", "WavySpinBall"][location]
118:       when 3      # Double trainer
119:         anim = "FourBallBurst"
120:       end
121:     end
122:     pbBattleAnimationCore(anim, viewport, location)
123:   end
124:   pbPushFade
125:   # Yield to the battle scene
126:   yield if block_given?
127:   # After the battle
128:   pbPopFade
129:   if $game_system.is_a?(Game_System)
130:     $game_system.bgm_resume(playingBGM)
131:     $game_system.bgs_resume(playingBGS)
132:   end
133:   $game_temp.memorized_bgm            = nil
134:   $game_temp.memorized_bgm_position   = 0
135:   $PokemonGlobal.nextBattleBGM        = nil
136:   $PokemonGlobal.nextBattleVictoryBGM = nil
137:   $PokemonGlobal.nextBattleCaptureME  = nil
138:   $PokemonGlobal.nextBattleBack       = nil
139:   $PokemonEncounters.reset_step_count
140:   # Fade back to the overworld in 0.4 seconds
141:   viewport.color = Color.black
142:   timer_start = System.uptime
143:   loop do
144:     Graphics.update
145:     Input.update
146:     pbUpdateSceneMap
147:     viewport.color.alpha = 255 * (1 - ((System.uptime - timer_start) / 0.4))
148:     break if viewport.color.alpha <= 0
149:   end
150:   viewport.dispose
151:   $game_temp.in_battle = false
152: end

154: def pbBattleAnimationCore(anim, viewport, location, num_flashes = 2)
155:   # Initial screen flashing
156:   if num_flashes > 0
157:     c = (location == 2 || PBDayNight.isNight?) ? 0 : 255   # Dark=black, light=white
158:     viewport.color = Color.new(c, c, c)   # Fade to black/white a few times
159:     half_flash_time = 0.2   # seconds
160:     num_flashes.times do   # 2 flashes
161:       fade_out = false
162:       timer_start = System.uptime
163:       loop do
164:         if fade_out
165:           viewport.color.alpha = lerp(255, 0, half_flash_time, timer_start, System.uptime)
166:         else
167:           viewport.color.alpha = lerp(0, 255, half_flash_time, timer_start, System.uptime)
168:         end
169:         Graphics.update
170:         pbUpdateSceneMap
171:         break if fade_out && viewport.color.alpha <= 0
172:         if !fade_out && viewport.color.alpha >= 255
173:           fade_out = true
174:           timer_start = System.uptime
175:         end
176:       end
177:     end
178:   end
179:   # Take screenshot of game, for use in some animations
180:   $game_temp.background_bitmap&.dispose
181:   $game_temp.background_bitmap = Graphics.snap_to_bitmap
182:   # Play main animation
183:   Graphics.freeze
184:   viewport.color = Color.black   # Ensure screen is black
185:   Graphics.transition(25, "Graphics/Transitions/" + anim)
186:   # Slight pause after animation before starting up the battle scene
187:   pbWait(0.1)
188: end

269: #===============================================================================
270: # Play the original Vs. Trainer battle transition animation for any single
271: # trainer battle where the following graphics exist in the Graphics/Transitions/
272: # folder for the opponent:
273: #   * "vsTrainer_TRAINERTYPE.png" and "vsBar_TRAINERTYPE.png"
274: #===============================================================================
275: ##### VS. animation, by Luka S.J. #####
276: ##### Tweaked by Maruno           #####
277: SpecialBattleIntroAnimations.register("alternate_vs_trainer_animation", 50,   # Priority 50
278:   proc { |battle_type, foe, location|   # Condition
279:     next false if battle_type.even? || foe.length != 1   # Trainer battle against 1 trainer
280:     tr_type = foe[0].trainer_type
281:     next pbResolveBitmap("Graphics/Transitions/vsTrainer_#{tr_type}") &&
282:          pbResolveBitmap("Graphics/Transitions/vsBar_#{tr_type}")
283:   },
284:   proc { |viewport, battle_type, foe, location|   # Animation
285:     # Determine filenames of graphics to be used
286:     tr_type = foe[0].trainer_type
287:     trainer_bar_graphic = sprintf("vsBar_%s", tr_type.to_s) rescue nil
288:     trainer_graphic     = sprintf("vsTrainer_%s", tr_type.to_s) rescue nil
289:     player_tr_type = $player.trainer_type
290:     outfit = $player.outfit
291:     player_bar_graphic = sprintf("vsBar_%s_%d", player_tr_type.to_s, outfit) rescue nil
292:     if !pbResolveBitmap("Graphics/Transitions/" + player_bar_graphic)
293:       player_bar_graphic = sprintf("vsBar_%s", player_tr_type.to_s) rescue nil
294:     end
295:     player_graphic = sprintf("vsTrainer_%s_%d", player_tr_type.to_s, outfit) rescue nil
296:     if !pbResolveBitmap("Graphics/Transitions/" + player_graphic)
297:       player_graphic = sprintf("vsTrainer_%s", player_tr_type.to_s) rescue nil
298:     end
299:     # Set up viewports
300:     viewplayer = Viewport.new(0, Graphics.height / 3, Graphics.width / 2, 128)
301:     viewplayer.z = viewport.z
302:     viewopp = Viewport.new(Graphics.width / 2, Graphics.height / 3, Graphics.width / 2, 128)
303:     viewopp.z = viewport.z
304:     viewvs = Viewport.new(0, 0, Graphics.width, Graphics.height)
305:     viewvs.z = viewport.z
306:     # Set up sprites
307:     fade = Sprite.new(viewport)
308:     fade.bitmap  = RPG::Cache.transition("vsFlash")
309:     fade.tone    = Tone.new(-255, -255, -255)
310:     fade.opacity = 100
311:     overlay = Sprite.new(viewport)
312:     overlay.bitmap = Bitmap.new(Graphics.width, Graphics.height)
313:     pbSetSystemFont(overlay.bitmap)
314:     xoffset = ((Graphics.width / 2) / 10) * 10
315:     bar1 = Sprite.new(viewplayer)
316:     bar1.bitmap = RPG::Cache.transition(player_bar_graphic)
317:     bar1.x      = -xoffset
318:     bar2 = Sprite.new(viewopp)
319:     bar2.bitmap = RPG::Cache.transition(trainer_bar_graphic)
320:     bar2.x      = xoffset
321:     vs_x = Graphics.width / 2
322:     vs_y = Graphics.height / 1.5
323:     vs = Sprite.new(viewvs)
324:     vs.bitmap  = RPG::Cache.transition("vs")
325:     vs.ox      = vs.bitmap.width / 2
326:     vs.oy      = vs.bitmap.height / 2
327:     vs.x       = vs_x
328:     vs.y       = vs_y
329:     vs.visible = false
330:     flash = Sprite.new(viewvs)
331:     flash.bitmap  = RPG::Cache.transition("vsFlash")
332:     flash.opacity = 0
333:     # Animate bars sliding in from either side
334:     pbWait(0.25) do |delta_t|
335:       bar1.x = lerp(-xoffset, 0, 0.25, delta_t)
336:       bar2.x = lerp(xoffset, 0, 0.25, delta_t)
337:     end
338:     bar1.dispose
339:     bar2.dispose
340:     # Make whole screen flash white
341:     pbSEPlay("Vs flash")
342:     pbSEPlay("Vs sword")
343:     flash.opacity = 255
344:     # Replace bar sprites with AnimatedPlanes, set up trainer sprites
345:     bar1 = AnimatedPlane.new(viewplayer)
346:     bar1.bitmap = RPG::Cache.transition(player_bar_graphic)
347:     bar2 = AnimatedPlane.new(viewopp)
348:     bar2.bitmap = RPG::Cache.transition(trainer_bar_graphic)
349:     player = Sprite.new(viewplayer)
350:     player.bitmap = RPG::Cache.transition(player_graphic)
351:     player.x      = -xoffset
352:     trainer = Sprite.new(viewopp)
353:     trainer.bitmap = RPG::Cache.transition(trainer_graphic)
354:     trainer.x      = xoffset
355:     trainer.tone   = Tone.new(-255, -255, -255)
356:     # Dim the flash and make the trainer sprites appear, while animating bars
357:     pbWait(1.2) do |delta_t|
358:       flash.opacity = lerp(255, 0, 0.25, delta_t)
359:       bar1.ox = lerp(0, -bar1.bitmap.width * 3, 1.2, delta_t)
360:       bar2.ox = lerp(0, bar2.bitmap.width * 3, 1.2, delta_t)
361:       player.x = lerp(-xoffset, 0, 0.25, delta_t - 0.6)
362:       trainer.x = lerp(xoffset, 0, 0.25, delta_t - 0.6)
363:     end
364:     player.x = 0
365:     trainer.x = 0
366:     # Make whole screen flash white again
367:     flash.opacity = 255
368:     pbSEPlay("Vs sword")
369:     # Make the Vs logo and trainer names appear, and reset trainer's tone
370:     vs.visible = true
371:     trainer.tone = Tone.new(0, 0, 0)
372:     trainername = foe[0].name
373:     textpos = [
374:       [$player.name, Graphics.width / 4, (Graphics.height / 1.5) + 16, :center,
375:        Color.new(248, 248, 248), Color.new(72, 72, 72)],
376:       [trainername, (Graphics.width / 4) + (Graphics.width / 2), (Graphics.height / 1.5) + 16, :center,
377:        Color.new(248, 248, 248), Color.new(72, 72, 72)]
378:     ]
379:     pbDrawTextPositions(overlay.bitmap, textpos)
380:     # Fade out flash, shudder Vs logo and expand it, and then fade to black
381:     shudder_time = 1.75
382:     zoom_time = 2.5
383:     pbWait(2.8) do |delta_t|
384:       if delta_t <= shudder_time
385:         flash.opacity = lerp(255, 0, 0.25, delta_t)   # Fade out the white flash
386:       elsif delta_t >= zoom_time
387:         flash.tone = Tone.new(-255, -255, -255)   # Make the flash black
388:         flash.opacity = lerp(0, 255, 0.25, delta_t - zoom_time)   # Fade to black
389:       end
390:       bar1.ox = lerp(0, -bar1.bitmap.width * 7, 2.8, delta_t)
391:       bar2.ox = lerp(0, bar2.bitmap.width * 7, 2.8, delta_t)
392:       if delta_t <= shudder_time
393:         # +2, -2, -2, +2, repeat
394:         period = (delta_t / 0.025).to_i % 4
395:         shudder_delta = [2, 0, -2, 0][period]
396:         vs.x = vs_x + shudder_delta
397:         vs.y = vs_y - shudder_delta
398:       elsif delta_t <= zoom_time
399:         vs.zoom_x = lerp(1.0, 7.0, zoom_time - shudder_time, delta_t - shudder_time)
400:         vs.zoom_y = vs.zoom_x
401:       end
402:     end
403:     # End of animation
404:     player.dispose
405:     trainer.dispose
406:     flash.dispose
407:     vs.dispose
408:     bar1.dispose
409:     bar2.dispose
410:     overlay.dispose
411:     fade.dispose
412:     viewvs.dispose
413:     viewopp.dispose
414:     viewplayer.dispose
415:     viewport.color = Color.black   # Ensure screen is black
416:   }
417: )

57:   # duration is time in 1/20ths of a second.
58:   def start_shake(power, speed, duration)
59:     @shake_power       = power
60:     @shake_speed       = speed
61:     @shake_duration    = duration / 20.0
62:     @shake_timer_start = $stats.play_time

72:   def update
73:     now = $stats.play_time
74:     if @tone_timer_start
75:       @tone.red = lerp(@tone_initial.red, @tone_target.red, @tone_duration, @tone_timer_start, now)
76:       @tone.green = lerp(@tone_initial.green, @tone_target.green, @tone_duration, @tone_timer_start, now)
77:       @tone.blue = lerp(@tone_initial.blue, @tone_target.blue, @tone_duration, @tone_timer_start, now)
78:       @tone.gray = lerp(@tone_initial.gray, @tone_target.gray, @tone_duration, @tone_timer_start, now)
79:       if now - @tone_timer_start >= @tone_duration
80:         @tone_initial = nil
81:         @tone_timer_start = nil
82:       end
83:     end
84:     if @flash_timer_start
85:       @flash_color.alpha = lerp(@flash_initial_alpha, 0, @flash_duration, @flash_timer_start, now)
86:       if now - @flash_timer_start >= @flash_duration
87:         @flash_initial_alpha = nil
88:         @flash_timer_start = nil
89:       end
90:     end
91:     if @shake_timer_start
92:       delta_t = now - @shake_timer_start
93:       movement_per_second = @shake_power * @shake_speed * 4
94:       limit = @shake_power * 2.5   # Maximum pixel displacement
95:       phase = (delta_t * movement_per_second / limit).to_i % 4
96:       case phase
97:       when 0, 2
98:         @shake = (movement_per_second * delta_t) % limit
99:         @shake *= -1 if phase == 2
100:       else
101:         @shake = limit - ((movement_per_second * delta_t) % limit)
102:         @shake *= -1 if phase == 3
103:       end
104:       if delta_t >= @shake_duration
105:         @shake_phase = phase if !@shake_phase || phase == 1 || phase == 3
106:         if phase != @shake_phase || @shake < 2
107:           @shake_timer_start = nil
108:           @shake = 0
109:         end
110:       end
111:     end
112:     if $game_temp.in_battle
113:       (51..100).each { |i| @pictures[i].update }
114:     else
115:       (1..50).each { |i|  @pictures[i].update }
116:     end
117:   end

45:   # Show Picture
46:   #     name       : file name
47:   #     origin     : starting point
48:   #     x          : x-coordinate
49:   #     y          : y-coordinate
50:   #     zoom_x     : x directional zoom rate
51:   #     zoom_y     : y directional zoom rate
52:   #     opacity    : opacity level

54:   def show(name, origin, x, y, zoom_x, zoom_y, opacity, blend_type)
55:     @name = name
56:     @origin = origin
57:     @x = x.to_f
58:     @y = y.to_f
59:     @zoom_x = zoom_x.to_f
60:     @zoom_y = zoom_y.to_f
61:     @opacity = opacity.to_f
62:     @blend_type = blend_type || 0
63:     @duration = 0
64:     @target_x = @x
65:     @target_y = @y
66:     @target_zoom_x = @zoom_x
67:     @target_zoom_y = @zoom_y
68:     @target_opacity = @opacity
69:     @tone = Tone.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
70:     @tone_target = Tone.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
71:     @tone_duration = 0
72:     @tone_timer_start = nil
73:     @angle = 0
74:     @rotate_speed = 0

77:   # Move Picture
78:   #     duration   : time in 1/20ths of a second
79:   #     origin     : starting point
80:   #     x          : x-coordinate
81:   #     y          : y-coordinate
82:   #     zoom_x     : x directional zoom rate
83:   #     zoom_y     : y directional zoom rate
84:   #     opacity    : opacity level
85:   #     blend_type : blend method
86:   def move(duration, origin, x, y, zoom_x, zoom_y, opacity, blend_type)
87:     @duration         = duration / 20.0
88:     @origin           = origin
89:     @initial_x        = @x
90:     @initial_y        = @y
91:     @target_x         = x.to_f
92:     @target_y         = y.to_f
93:     @initial_zoom_x   = @zoom_x
94:     @initial_zoom_y   = @zoom_y
95:     @target_zoom_x    = zoom_x.to_f
96:     @target_zoom_y    = zoom_y.to_f
97:     @initial_opacity  = @opacity
98:     @target_opacity   = opacity.to_f
99:     @blend_type       = blend_type || 0
100:     @move_timer_start = $stats.play_time
101:   end
102: 
103:   # Change Rotation Speed
104:   #     speed : rotation speed (degrees to change per 1/20th of a second)
105:   def rotate(speed)
106:     @rotate_timer = (speed == 0) ? nil : System.uptime   # Time since last frame
107:     @rotate_speed = speed
108:   end
109: 
110:   # Start Change of Color Tone
111:   #     tone     : color tone
112:   #     duration : time in 1/20ths of a second
113:   def start_tone_change(tone, duration)
114:     if duration == 0
115:       @tone = tone.clone
116:       return
117:     end
118:     @tone_initial = @tone.clone
119:     @tone_target = tone.clone
120:     @tone_duration = duration / 20.0
121:     @tone_timer_start = $stats.play_time
122:   end

124:   def erase
125:     @name = ""
126:   end

128:   def update
129:     return if @name == ""
130:     now = $stats.play_time
131:     if @move_timer_start
132:       @x = lerp(@initial_x, @target_x, @duration, @move_timer_start, now)
133:       @y = lerp(@initial_y, @target_y, @duration, @move_timer_start, now)
134:       @zoom_x = lerp(@initial_zoom_x, @target_zoom_x, @duration, @move_timer_start, now)
135:       @zoom_y = lerp(@initial_zoom_y, @target_zoom_y, @duration, @move_timer_start, now)
136:       @opacity = lerp(@initial_opacity, @target_opacity, @duration, @move_timer_start, now)
137:       if now - @move_timer_start >= @duration
138:         @initial_x        = nil
139:         @initial_y        = nil
140:         @initial_zoom_x   = nil
141:         @initial_zoom_y   = nil
142:         @initial_opacity  = nil
143:         @move_timer_start = nil
144:       end
145:     end
146:     if @tone_timer_start
147:       @tone.red = lerp(@tone_initial.red, @tone_target.red, @tone_duration, @tone_timer_start, now)
148:       @tone.green = lerp(@tone_initial.green, @tone_target.green, @tone_duration, @tone_timer_start, now)
149:       @tone.blue = lerp(@tone_initial.blue, @tone_target.blue, @tone_duration, @tone_timer_start, now)
150:       @tone.gray = lerp(@tone_initial.gray, @tone_target.gray, @tone_duration, @tone_timer_start, now)
151:       if now - @tone_timer_start >= @tone_duration
152:         @tone_initial = nil
153:         @tone_timer_start = nil
154:       end
155:     end
156:     if @rotate_speed != 0
157:       @rotate_timer = System.uptime if !@rotate_timer
158:       @angle += @rotate_speed * (System.uptime - @rotate_timer) * 20.0
159:       @rotate_timer = System.uptime
160:       while @angle < 0
161:         @angle += 360
162:       end
163:       @angle %= 360
164:     end
165:   end
166: end

524: def pbScrollMapTo(x, y, speed = 4)
525:   if !$game_map.valid?(x, y)
526:     print "pbScrollMapTo: given x,y is invalid"

528:   elsif !(0..6).include?(speed)
529:     print "pbScrollMapTo: invalid speed (0-6 only)"

533:   screen_offset_x = (Graphics.width - Game_Map::TILE_WIDTH) * Game_Map::X_SUBPIXELS / 2
534:   screen_offset_y = (Graphics.height - Game_Map::TILE_HEIGHT) * Game_Map::Y_SUBPIXELS / 2

536:   current_tile_y = ($game_map.display_y + screen_offset_y) / Game_Map::REAL_RES_Y

142:       if @bitmaps[filename]
143:         @load_counts[filename] += 1
144:         return

146:       orig_bitmap = pbGetAutotile(filename)
147:       @bitmap_wraps[filename] = false

1: #===============================================================================
2: # This module is a little fix that works around PC hardware limitations. Since
3: # Essentials isn't working with software rendering anymore, it now has to deal
4: # with the limits of the GPU. For the most part this is no big deal, but people
5: # do have some really big tilesets.
6: #
7: # The fix is simple enough: If your tileset is too big, a new bitmap will be
8: # constructed with all the excess pixels sent to the image's right side. This
9: # basically means that you now have a limit far higher than you should ever
10: # actually need.
11: #
12: # Hardware limit   -> max tileset length:
13: # 1024px           -> 4096px
14: # 2048px           -> 16384px   (enough to get the normal limit)
15: # 4096px           -> 65536px   (enough to load pretty much any tileset)
16: # 8192px           -> 262144px
17: # 16384px          -> 1048576px (what most people have at this point)
18: #===============================================================================
19: class TilemapRenderer
20:   module TilesetWrapper
21:     TILESET_WIDTH        = SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH * TILESET_TILES_PER_ROW
22:     # Looks useless, but covers weird numbers given to mkxp.json or a funky driver
23:     MAX_TEX_SIZE         = (Bitmap.max_size / 1024) * 1024
24:     MAX_TEX_SIZE_BOOSTED = (MAX_TEX_SIZE**2) / TILESET_WIDTH
25: 
26:     module_function
27: 
28:     def wrapTileset(originalbmp)
29:       width = originalbmp.width
30:       height = originalbmp.height
31:       if width == TILESET_WIDTH && originalbmp.mega?
32:         columns = (height / MAX_TEX_SIZE.to_f).ceil
33:         if columns * TILESET_WIDTH > MAX_TEX_SIZE
34:           raise "Tileset is too long!\n\nSIZE: #{originalbmp.height}px\nHARDWARE LIMIT: #{MAX_TEX_SIZE}px\nBOOSTED LIMIT: #{MAX_TEX_SIZE_BOOSTED}px"
35:         end
36:         bmp = Bitmap.new(TILESET_WIDTH * columns, MAX_TEX_SIZE)
37:         remainder = height % MAX_TEX_SIZE
38:         remainder = MAX_TEX_SIZE if remainder == 0
39:         columns.times do |col|
40:           srcrect = Rect.new(0, col * MAX_TEX_SIZE, width, (col + 1 == columns) ? remainder : MAX_TEX_SIZE)
41:           bmp.blt(col * TILESET_WIDTH, 0, originalbmp, srcrect)
42:         end
43:         return bmp
44:       end
45:       return originalbmp
46:     end
47: 
48:     def getWrappedRect(src_rect)
49:       ret = Rect.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
50:       col = (src_rect.y / MAX_TEX_SIZE.to_f).floor
51:       ret.x = (col * TILESET_WIDTH) + src_rect.x.clamp(0, TILESET_WIDTH)
52:       ret.y = src_rect.y % MAX_TEX_SIZE
53:       ret.width = src_rect.width.clamp(0, TILESET_WIDTH - src_rect.x)
54:       ret.height = src_rect.height.clamp(0, MAX_TEX_SIZE)
55:       return ret
56:     end
57: 
58:     #---------------------------------------------------------------------------
59: 
60:     private
61: 
62:     def blitWrappedPixels(destX, destY, dest, src, srcrect)
63:       if srcrect.y + srcrect.width < MAX_TEX_SIZE
64:         # Save the processing power
65:         dest.blt(destX, destY, src, srcrect)
66:         return
67:       end
68:       merge = (srcrect.y % MAX_TEX_SIZE) > ((srcrect.y + srcrect.height) % MAX_TEX_SIZE)
69:       srcrect_mod = getWrappedRect(srcrect)
70:       if merge
71:         # FIXME: won't work on heights longer than two columns, but nobody should need
72:         # more than 32k pixels high at once anyway
73:         side = {
74:           :a => MAX_TEX_SIZE - srcrect_mod.y,
75:           :b => srcrect_mod.height - MAX_TEX_SIZE + srcrect_mod.y
76:         }
77:         dest.blt(destX, destY, src, Rect.new(srcrect_mod.x, srcrect_mod.y, srcrect_mod.width, side[:a]))
78:         dest.blt(destX, destY + side[:a], src, Rect.new(srcrect_mod.x + TILESET_WIDTH, 0, srcrect_mod.width, side[:b]))
79:       else
80:         dest.blt(destX, destY, src, srcrect_mod)
81:       end
82:     end
83: 
84:     def stretchBlitWrappedPixels(destrect, dest, src, srcrect)
85:       if srcrect.y + srcrect.width < MAX_TEX_SIZE
86:         # Save the processing power
87:         dest.stretch_blt(destrect, src, srcrect)
88:         return
89:       end
90:       # Does a regular blit to a non-megasurface, then stretch_blts that to
91:       # the destination. Yes it is slow
92:       tmp = Bitmap.new(srcrect.width, srcrect.height)
93:       blitWrappedPixels(0, 0, tmp, src, srcrect)
94:       dest.stretch_blt(destrect, tmp, Rect.new(0, 0, srcrect.width, srcrect.height))
95:     end
96:   end
97: end

5:     module_function

7:     # This doesn't allow for cache sizes smaller than 768, but if that applies
8:     # to you, you've got bigger problems.
9:     def expand(bitmap)
10:       return bitmap if bitmap.height == SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT
11:       expanded_format = (bitmap.height == SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT * 6)
12:       wrap = false
13:       if MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE < TILES_PER_AUTOTILE * SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT
14:         wrap = true   # Each autotile will occupy two columns instead of one
15:       end
16:       frames_count = [bitmap.width / (3 * SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH), 1].max
17:       new_bitmap = Bitmap.new(frames_count * (wrap ? 2 : 1) * SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH,
18:                               TILES_PER_AUTOTILE * SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT / (wrap ? 2 : 1))
19:       rect = Rect.new(0, 0, SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH / 2, SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT / 2)
20:       TILES_PER_AUTOTILE.times do |id|
21:         pattern = TileDrawingHelper::AUTOTILE_PATTERNS[id >> 3][id % TILESET_TILES_PER_ROW]
22:         wrap_offset_x = (wrap && id >= TILES_PER_AUTOTILE / 2) ? SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH : 0
23:         wrap_offset_y = (wrap && id >= TILES_PER_AUTOTILE / 2) ? (TILES_PER_AUTOTILE / 2) * SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT : 0
24:         frames_count.times do |frame|
25:           if expanded_format && [1, 2, 4, 8].include?(id)
26:             dest_x = frame * SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH * (wrap ? 2 : 1)
27:             dest_x += wrap_offset_x
28:             next if dest_x > MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE
29:             dest_y = id * SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT
30:             dest_y -= wrap_offset_y
31:             next if dest_y > MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE
32:             case id
33:             when 1   # Top left corner
34:               new_bitmap.blt(dest_x, dest_y, bitmap,
35:                              Rect.new(frame * SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH * 3, SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT * 4,
36:                                       SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH, SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT))
37:             when 2   # Top right corner
38:               new_bitmap.blt(dest_x, dest_y, bitmap,
39:                              Rect.new(SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH + (frame * SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH * 3), SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT * 4,
40:                                       SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH, SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT))
41:             when 4   # Bottom right corner
42:               new_bitmap.blt(dest_x, dest_y, bitmap,
43:                              Rect.new(SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH + (frame * SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH * 3), SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT * 5,
44:                                       SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH, SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT))
45:             when 8   # Bottom left corner
46:               new_bitmap.blt(dest_x, dest_y, bitmap,
47:                              Rect.new(frame * SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH * 3, SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT * 5,
48:                                       SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH, SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT))
49:             end
50:             next
51:           end
52:           pattern.each_with_index do |src_chunk, i|
53:             real_src_chunk = src_chunk - 1
54:             dest_x = (i % 2) * SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH / 2
55:             dest_x += frame * SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH * (wrap ? 2 : 1)
56:             dest_x += wrap_offset_x
57:             next if dest_x > MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE
58:             dest_y = (i / 2) * SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT / 2
59:             dest_y += id * SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT
60:             dest_y -= wrap_offset_y
61:             next if dest_y > MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE
62:             rect.x = (real_src_chunk % 6) * SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH / 2
63:             rect.x += SOURCE_TILE_WIDTH * 3 * frame
64:             rect.y = (real_src_chunk / 6) * SOURCE_TILE_HEIGHT / 2
65:             new_bitmap.blt(dest_x, dest_y, bitmap, rect)
66:           end
67:         end
68:       end
69:       return new_bitmap
70:     end
71:   end
72: end

15:     Tone.new(-70, -90,  15, 55),   # Night

21:     Tone.new(-40, -50, -35, 50),   # Day/morning
22:     Tone.new(-20, -25, -15, 20),   # Day/morning
23:     Tone.new(  0,   0,   0,  0),   # Day
24:     Tone.new(  0,   0,   0,  0),   # Day
25:     Tone.new(  0,   0,   0,  0),   # Day             # Noon
26:     Tone.new(  0,   0,   0,  0),   # Day
27:     Tone.new(  0,   0,   0,  0),   # Day/afternoon
28:     Tone.new(  0,   0,   0,  0),   # Day/afternoon
29:     Tone.new(  0,   0,   0,  0),   # Day/afternoon
30:     Tone.new(  0,   0,   0,  0),   # Day/afternoon
31:     Tone.new( -5, -30, -20,  0),   # Day/evening     # 6PM
32:     Tone.new(-15, -60, -10, 20),   # Day/evening
33:     Tone.new(-15, -60, -10, 20),   # Day/evening
34:     Tone.new(-40, -75,   5, 40),   # Night
35:     Tone.new(-70, -90,  15, 55),   # Night
36:     Tone.new(-70, -90,  15, 55)    # Night
37:   ]
38:   CACHED_TONE_LIFETIME = 30   # In seconds; recalculates overworld tone once per this time
39:   @cachedTone = nil
40:   @dayNightToneLastUpdate = nil
41:   @oneOverSixty = 1 / 60.0
42: 
43:   # Returns true if it's day.
44:   def self.isDay?(time = nil)
45:     time = pbGetTimeNow if !time
46:     return (time.hour >= 5 && time.hour < 20)
47:   end
48: 
49:   # Returns true if it's night.
50:   def self.isNight?(time = nil)
51:     time = pbGetTimeNow if !time
52:     return (time.hour >= 20 || time.hour < 5)
53:   end
54: 
55:   # Returns true if it's morning.
56:   def self.isMorning?(time = nil)
57:     time = pbGetTimeNow if !time
58:     return (time.hour >= 5 && time.hour < 10)
59:   end
60: 
61:   # Returns true if it's the afternoon.
62:   def self.isAfternoon?(time = nil)
63:     time = pbGetTimeNow if !time
64:     return (time.hour >= 14 && time.hour < 17)
65:   end
66: 
67:   # Returns true if it's the evening.
68:   def self.isEvening?(time = nil)
69:     time = pbGetTimeNow if !time
70:     return (time.hour >= 17 && time.hour < 20)
71:   end

73:   # Gets a number representing the amount of daylight (0=full night, 255=full day).
74:   def self.getShade
75:     time = pbGetDayNightMinutes
76:     time = (24 * 60) - time if time > (12 * 60)
77:     return 255 * time / (12 * 60)
78:   end
79: 
80:   # Gets a Tone object representing a suggested shading
81:   # tone for the current time of day.
82:   def self.getTone
83:     @cachedTone = Tone.new(0, 0, 0) if !@cachedTone
84:     return @cachedTone if !Settings::TIME_SHADING
85:     if !@dayNightToneLastUpdate || (System.uptime - @dayNightToneLastUpdate >= CACHED_TONE_LIFETIME)
86:       getToneInternal
87:       @dayNightToneLastUpdate = System.uptime
88:     end
89:     return @cachedTone
90:   end
91: 
92:   def self.pbGetDayNightMinutes
93:     now = pbGetTimeNow   # Get the current in-game time
94:     return (now.hour * 60) + now.min
95:   end
96: 
97:   def self.getToneInternal
98:     # Calculates the tone for the current frame, used for day/night effects
99:     realMinutes = pbGetDayNightMinutes
100:     hour   = realMinutes / 60
101:     minute = realMinutes % 60
102:     tone         = PBDayNight::HOURLY_TONES[hour]
103:     nexthourtone = PBDayNight::HOURLY_TONES[(hour + 1) % 24]
104:     # Calculate current tint according to current and next hour's tint and
105:     # depending on current minute
106:     @cachedTone.red   = ((nexthourtone.red - tone.red) * minute * @oneOverSixty) + tone.red
107:     @cachedTone.green = ((nexthourtone.green - tone.green) * minute * @oneOverSixty) + tone.green
108:     @cachedTone.blue  = ((nexthourtone.blue - tone.blue) * minute * @oneOverSixty) + tone.blue
109:     @cachedTone.gray  = ((nexthourtone.gray - tone.gray) * minute * @oneOverSixty) + tone.gray
110:   end
111: end

117:   return if !$scene.is_a?(Scene_Map)
118:   if Settings::TIME_SHADING && $game_map.metadata&.outdoor_map
119:     tone = PBDayNight.getTone
120:     object.tone.set(tone.red, tone.green, tone.blue, tone.gray)
121:   else
122:     object.tone.set(0, 0, 0, 0)
123:   end

328:   event = $game_player if !event
329:   return [0, 0, 0] if !event
330:   x = event.x
331:   y = event.y
332:   direction = event.direction if !direction
333:   x_offset = [0, -1, 0, 1, -1, 0, 1, -1, 0, 1][direction]
334:   y_offset = [0, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, -1, -1, -1][direction]

338: # Returns whether event is in line with the player, is facing the player and is
339: # within distance tiles of the player.
340: def pbEventFacesPlayer?(event, player, distance)
341:   return false if !event || !player || distance <= 0
342:   x_min = x_max = y_min = y_max = -1
343:   case event.direction
344:   when 2   # Down
345:     x_min = event.x
346:     x_max = event.x + event.width - 1
347:     y_min = event.y + 1
348:     y_max = event.y + distance
349:   when 4   # Left
350:     x_min = event.x - distance
351:     x_max = event.x - 1
352:     y_min = event.y - event.height + 1
353:     y_max = event.y
354:   when 6   # Right
355:     x_min = event.x + event.width
356:     x_max = event.x + event.width - 1 + distance
357:     y_min = event.y - event.height + 1
358:     y_max = event.y
359:   when 8   # Up
360:     x_min = event.x
361:     x_max = event.x + event.width - 1
362:     y_min = event.y - event.height + 1 - distance
363:     y_max = event.y - event.height
364:   else
365:     return false
366:   end
367:   return player.x >= x_min && player.x <= x_max &&
368:          player.y >= y_min && player.y <= y_max
369: end
370: 
371: # Returns whether event is able to walk up to the player.
372: def pbEventCanReachPlayer?(event, player, distance)
373:   return false if !pbEventFacesPlayer?(event, player, distance)
374:   delta_x = (event.direction == 6) ? 1 : (event.direction == 4) ? -1 : 0
375:   delta_y = (event.direction == 2) ? 1 : (event.direction == 8) ? -1 : 0
376:   case event.direction
377:   when 2   # Down
378:     real_distance = player.y - event.y - 1
379:   when 4   # Left
380:     real_distance = event.x - player.x - 1
381:   when 6   # Right
382:     real_distance = player.x - event.x - event.width
383:   when 8   # Up
384:     real_distance = event.y - event.height - player.y
385:   end
386:   if real_distance > 0
387:     real_distance.times do |i|
388:       return false if !event.can_move_from_coordinate?(event.x + (i * delta_x), event.y + (i * delta_y), event.direction)
389:     end
390:   end
391:   return true
392: end
393: 
394: # Returns whether the two events are standing next to each other and facing each
395: # other.
396: def pbFacingEachOther(event1, event2)
397:   return pbEventFacesPlayer?(event1, event2, 1) && pbEventFacesPlayer?(event2, event1, 1)
398: end

40:   def self.tableNeighbors(data, x, y, layer = nil)
41:     return 0 if x < 0 || x >= data.xsize
42:     return 0 if y < 0 || y >= data.ysize
43:     if layer.nil?

46:       t = data[x, y, layer]
47:     end
48:     xp1 = [x + 1, data.xsize - 1].min
49:     yp1 = [y + 1, data.ysize - 1].min
50:     xm1 = [x - 1, 0].max
51:     ym1 = [y - 1, 0].max
52:     i = 0
53:     if layer.nil?
54:       i |= 0x01 if data[  x, ym1] == t   # N
55:       i |= 0x02 if data[xp1, ym1] == t   # NE
56:       i |= 0x04 if data[xp1,   y] == t   # E
57:       i |= 0x08 if data[xp1, yp1] == t   # SE
58:       i |= 0x10 if data[  x, yp1] == t   # S
59:       i |= 0x20 if data[xm1, yp1] == t   # SW
60:       i |= 0x40 if data[xm1,   y] == t   # W
61:       i |= 0x80 if data[xm1, ym1] == t   # NW

20:   pkmn.shadow = false

65:     @mosaicbitmap2&.dispose

80:   def mosaicRefresh(bitmap)
81:     return if @inrefresh
82:     @inrefresh = true
83:     @oldbitmap = bitmap
84:     if @mosaic <= 0 || !@oldbitmap
85:       @mosaicbitmap&.dispose
86:       @mosaicbitmap = nil
87:       @mosaicbitmap2&.dispose
88:       @mosaicbitmap2 = nil
89:       self.bitmap = @oldbitmap
90:     else
91:       newWidth  = [(@oldbitmap.width / @mosaic), 1].max
92:       newHeight = [(@oldbitmap.height / @mosaic), 1].max
93:       @mosaicbitmap2&.dispose
94:       @mosaicbitmap = pbDoEnsureBitmap(@mosaicbitmap, newWidth, newHeight)
95:       @mosaicbitmap.clear
96:       @mosaicbitmap2 = pbDoEnsureBitmap(@mosaicbitmap2, @oldbitmap.width, @oldbitmap.height)
97:       @mosaicbitmap2.clear
98:       @mosaicbitmap.stretch_blt(Rect.new(0, 0, newWidth, newHeight), @oldbitmap, @oldbitmap.rect)
99:       @mosaicbitmap2.stretch_blt(
100:         Rect.new((-@mosaic / 2) + 1, (-@mosaic / 2) + 1, @mosaicbitmap2.width, @mosaicbitmap2.height),
101:         @mosaicbitmap, Rect.new(0, 0, newWidth, newHeight)
102:       )
103:       self.bitmap = @mosaicbitmap2
104:     end
105:     @inrefresh = false
106:   end
107: end

5:   attr_reader :maps
6: 
7:   def initialize(id)
8:     @maps       = []
9:     @fixup      = false
10:     @mapChanged = false   # transient instance variable
11:     setup(id)
12:   end

14:   # Clears all maps and sets up the current map with id. This function also sets
15:   # the positions of neighboring maps and notifies the game system of a map
16:   # change.
17:   def setup(id)
18:     @maps.clear
19:     @maps[0] = Game_Map.new
20:     @mapIndex = 0
21:     oldID = ($game_map) ? $game_map.map_id : 0
22:     setMapChanging(id, @maps[0]) if oldID != 0 && oldID != @maps[0].map_id
23:     $game_map = @maps[0]
24:     @maps[0].setup(id)
25:     setMapsInRange
26:     setMapChanged(oldID)
27:   end

29:   def map
30:     @mapIndex = 0 if !@mapIndex || @mapIndex < 0
31:     return @maps[@mapIndex] if @maps[@mapIndex]
32:     raise "No maps in save file... (mapIndex=#{@mapIndex})" if @maps.length == 0
33:     if @maps[0]
34:       echoln "Using next map, may be incorrect (mapIndex=#{@mapIndex}, length=#{@maps.length})"
35:       return @maps[0]
36:     end
37:     raise "No maps in save file... (all maps empty; mapIndex=#{@mapIndex})"
38:   end

40:   def hasMap?(id)
41:     @maps.each do |map|
42:       return true if map.map_id == id
43:     end
44:     return false
45:   end
46: 
47:   def getMapIndex(id)
48:     @maps.length.times do |i|
49:       return i if @maps[i].map_id == id
50:     end
51:     return -1
52:   end
53: 
54:   def getMap(id, add = true)
55:     @maps.each do |map|
56:       return map if map.map_id == id
57:     end
58:     map = Game_Map.new
59:     map.setup(id)
60:     @maps.push(map) if add
61:     return map
62:   end

64:   def getMapNoAdd(id)
65:     return getMap(id, false)
66:   end

68:   def getNewMap(playerX, playerY, map_id = nil)
69:     id = map_id || $game_map.map_id
70:     MapFactoryHelper.eachConnectionForMap(id) do |conn|
71:       mapidB = nil
72:       newx = 0
73:       newy = 0
74:       if conn[0] == id
75:         mapidB = conn[3]
76:         mapB = MapFactoryHelper.getMapDims(conn[3])
77:         newx = conn[4] - conn[1] + playerX
78:         newy = conn[5] - conn[2] + playerY
79:       else
80:         mapidB = conn[0]
81:         mapB = MapFactoryHelper.getMapDims(conn[0])
82:         newx = conn[1] - conn[4] + playerX
83:         newy = conn[2] - conn[5] + playerY
84:       end
85:       if newx >= 0 && newx < mapB[0] && newy >= 0 && newy < mapB[1]
86:         return [getMapNoAdd(mapidB), newx, newy] if map_id

88:       end

2: # ** Interpreter
3: #-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
4: #  This interpreter runs event commands. This class is used within the
5: #  Game_System class and the Game_Event class.
6: #===============================================================================
7: class Interpreter
8:   # Object Initialization
9:   #     depth : nest depth
10:   #     main  : main flag
11:   def initialize(depth = 0, main = false)
12:     @depth = depth
13:     @main  = main
14:     if depth > 100
15:       print("Common event call has exceeded maximum limit.")
16:       exit
17:     end
18:     clear
19:   end
20: 
21:   def inspect
22:     str = super.chop
23:     str << sprintf(" @event_id: %d>", @event_id)
24:     return str
25:   end
26: 
27:   def clear
28:     @map_id             = 0       # map ID when starting up
29:     @event_id           = 0
30:     @message_waiting    = false   # waiting for message to end
31:     @move_route_waiting = false   # waiting for move completion
32:     @wait_count         = 0
33:     @wait_start         = nil
34:     @child_interpreter  = nil
35:     @branch             = {}
36:     @buttonInput        = false
37:     @hidden_choices     = []
38:     @renamed_choices    = []
39:     end_follower_overrides
40:   end
41: 
42:   # Event Setup
43:   #     list     : list of event commands
44:   #     event_id : event ID
45:   def setup(list, event_id, map_id = nil)
46:     clear
47:     @map_id = map_id || $game_map.map_id
48:     @event_id = event_id
49:     @list = list
50:     @index = 0
51:     @branch.clear
52:   end
53: 
54:   def setup_starting_event
55:     $game_map.refresh if $game_map.need_refresh
56:     # Set up common event if one wants to start
57:     if $game_temp.common_event_id > 0
58:       setup($data_common_events[$game_temp.common_event_id].list, 0)
59:       $game_temp.common_event_id = 0
60:       return
61:     end
62:     # Check all map events for one that wants to start, and set it up
63:     $game_map.events.each_value do |event|
64:       next if !event.starting
65:       if event.trigger < 3   # Isn't autorun or parallel processing
66:         event.lock
67:         event.clear_starting
68:       end
69:       setup(event.list, event.id, event.map.map_id)
70:       return
71:     end
72:     # Check all common events for one that is autorun, and set it up
73:     $data_common_events.compact.each do |common_event|
74:       next if common_event.trigger != 1 || !$game_switches[common_event.switch_id]
75:       setup(common_event.list, 0)
76:       return
77:     end
78:   end
79: 
80:   def running?
81:     return !@list.nil?
82:   end
83: 
84:   def update
85:     @loop_count = 0
86:     loop do
87:       @loop_count += 1
88:       if @loop_count > 100   # Call Graphics.update for freeze prevention
89:         Graphics.update
90:         @loop_count = 0
91:       end
92:       # If this interpreter's map isn't the current map or connected to it,
93:       # forget this interpreter's event ID
94:       if $game_map.map_id != @map_id && !$map_factory.areConnected?($game_map.map_id, @map_id)
95:         @event_id = 0
96:       end
97:       # Update child interpreter if one exists
98:       if @child_interpreter
99:         @child_interpreter.update
100:         @child_interpreter = nil if !@child_interpreter.running?
101:         return if @child_interpreter
102:       end
103:       # Do nothing if a message is being shown
104:       return if @message_waiting
105:       # Do nothing if any event or the player is in the middle of a move route
106:       if @move_route_waiting
107:         return if $game_player.move_route_forcing
108:         $game_map.events.each_value do |event|
109:           return if event.move_route_forcing
110:         end
111:         $game_temp.followers.each_follower do |event, follower|
112:           return if event.move_route_forcing
113:         end
114:         @move_route_waiting = false
115:       end
116:       # Do nothing if the player is jumping out of surfing
117:       return if $game_temp.ending_surf
118:       # Do nothing while waiting
119:       if @wait_count > 0
120:         return if System.uptime - @wait_start < @wait_count
121:         @wait_count = 0
122:         @wait_start = nil
123:       end
124:       # Do nothing if the pause menu is going to open
125:       return if $game_temp.menu_calling
126:       # If there are no commands in the list, try to find something that wants to run
127:       if @list.nil?
128:         setup_starting_event if @main
129:         return if @list.nil?   # Couldn't find anything that wants to run
130:       end
131:       # Execute the next command
132:       return if execute_command == false
133:       # Move to the next @index
134:       @index += 1
135:     end
136:   end
137: 
138:   def execute_script(script)
139:     begin
140:       result = eval(script)
141:       return result
142:     rescue Exception
143:       e = $!
144:       raise if e.is_a?(SystemExit) || e.class.to_s == "Reset"
145:       event = get_self
146:       # Gather text for error message
147:       message = pbGetExceptionMessage(e)
148:       backtrace_text = ""
149:       if e.is_a?(SyntaxError)
150:         script.each_line do |line|
151:           line.gsub!(/\s+$/, "")
152:           if line[/^\s*\(/]
153:             message += "\r\n***Line '#{line}' shouldn't begin with '('. Try putting the '('\r\n"
154:             message += "at the end of the previous line instead, or using 'extendtext.exe'."
155:           end
156:         end
157:       else
158:         backtrace_text += "\r\n"
159:         backtrace_text += "Backtrace:"
160:         e.backtrace[0, 10].each { |i| backtrace_text += "\r\n#{i}" }
161:         backtrace_text.gsub!(/Section(\d+)/) { $RGSS_SCRIPTS[$1.to_i][1] } rescue nil
162:         backtrace_text += "\r\n"
163:       end
164:       # Assemble error message
165:       err = "Script error in Interpreter\r\n"
166:       if $game_map
167:         map_name = (pbGetBasicMapNameFromId($game_map.map_id) rescue nil) || "???"
168:         if event
169:           err = "Script error in event #{event.id} (coords #{event.x},#{event.y}), map #{$game_map.map_id} (#{map_name})\r\n"
170:         else
171:           err = "Script error in Common Event, map #{$game_map.map_id} (#{map_name})\r\n"
172:         end
173:       end
174:       err += "Exception: #{e.class}\r\n"
175:       err += "Message: #{message}\r\n\r\n"
176:       err += "***Full script:\r\n#{script}"   # \r\n"
177:       err += backtrace_text
178:       # Raise error
179:       raise EventScriptError.new(err)
180:     end
181:   end

183:   def get_character(parameter = 0)
184:     case parameter
185:     when -1   # player
186:       return $game_player
187:     when 0    # this event
188:       events = $game_map.events
189:       return (events) ? events[@event_id] : nil
190:     else      # specific event
191:       events = $game_map.events
192:       return (events) ? events[parameter] : nil
193:     end
194:   end
195: 
196:   def get_player
197:     return get_character(-1)
198:   end
199: 
200:   def get_self
201:     return get_character(0)
202:   end
203: 
204:   def get_event(parameter)
205:     return get_character(parameter)
206:   end
207: 
208:   # Freezes all events on the map (for use at the beginning of common events)
209:   def pbGlobalLock
210:     $game_map.events.each_value { |event| event.minilock }
211:   end
212: 
213:   # Unfreezes all events on the map (for use at the end of common events)
214:   def pbGlobalUnlock
215:     $game_map.events.each_value { |event| event.unlock }
216:   end
217: 
218:   # Gets the next index in the interpreter, ignoring certain commands between messages
219:   def pbNextIndex(index)
220:     return -1 if !@list || @list.length == 0
221:     i = index + 1
222:     loop do
223:       return i if i >= @list.length - 1
224:       case @list[i].code
225:       when 118, 108, 408   # Label, Comment
226:         i += 1
227:       when 413             # Repeat Above
228:         i = pbRepeatAbove(i)
229:       when 113             # Break Loop
230:         i = pbBreakLoop(i)
231:       when 119             # Jump to Label
232:         newI = pbJumpToLabel(i, @list[i].parameters[0])
233:         i = (newI > i) ? newI : i + 1
234:       else
235:         return i
236:       end
237:     end
238:   end
239: 
240:   def pbRepeatAbove(index)
241:     index = @list[index].indent
242:     loop do
243:       index -= 1
244:       return index + 1 if @list[index].indent == indent
245:     end
246:   end
247: 
248:   def pbBreakLoop(index)
249:     indent = @list[index].indent
250:     temp_index = index
251:     loop do
252:       temp_index += 1
253:       return index + 1 if temp_index >= @list.size - 1
254:       return temp_index + 1 if @list[temp_index].code == 413 &&
255:                                @list[temp_index].indent < indent
256:     end
257:   end

260:     temp_index = 0
